subject: Re: Slot priority ask — Skylab vs AtlasAI (Q4 surge)
messages:
From: Maya Kline <maya.kline@skylab.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T14:05:00Z
Subject: Urgent: Q4 surge — reserved slots priority request

Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this. Quick background: Skylab goes live with a major feature in mid-Oct; we have committed Reserved Slots in our December window but our pre-production runs pushed into Oct/Nov and we now need an elevated allocation for a two-week peak (2027-10-18 to 2027-10-31). We understand AtlasAI has overlapping reserved commitments on the same pool.

Can Redwood prioritize our tranche for that two-week window or provide an alternative (burst/buy-in) we can accept? This launch date is firm; missing it would push our go-to-market by a quarter. Procurement is copied for contracting.

Attached: brief describing the window and expected TPU/GPU-hours.

Appreciate a quick read and any options — we need a decision by end of day 2027-09-14 to finalize scheduling with our release team.

— Maya
Maya Kline
Head of Infrastructure, Skylab
maya.kline@skylab.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maya Kline <maya.kline@skylab.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Q4 surge — reserved slots priority request

Maya — thanks, got it. I’m escalating internally to adjudicate between your request and existing AtlasAI commitments. Two quick asks so we can move fast: 1) confirm the hard window and hourly GPU-hours needed per day, and 2) share any flexibility on exact dates (even +/- 3 days helps).

I’ll table a proposed approach (temporary redistribution vs burst purchase vs cross-account credits) and circle back within the day. CC’ing Ben, Laura, and Rishi for capacity/contract guidance.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T16:00:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: Q4 surge — Skylab request (conflict with AtlasAI tranche)

Team — forwarding Skylab's note. Problem: Skylab is asking to prioritize slots inside the same reserved pool where AtlasAI has a higher-tier commitment for Dec; their two-week spike overlaps our busiest window for multiple Q4 deals.

Summary of constraints (see attached matrix):
- Skylab (deal SKY-2027-0421) requests +60% of their current reserved tranche for 2027-10-18 -> 2027-10-31.
- AtlasAI has a standing reserve that would be reduced if we reassign capacity; AtlasAI is enterprise with SLA credits and usage expectations.
- Burst pool capacity is limited; we can partially bridge but that will increase per-token cost and may require a temporary pricing amendment.

Options I see now:
A) Temporary redistribution: shift ~60% of AtlasAI's tranche for 14 days, compensate with credits and a one-off discount. Pros: meets Skylab launch. Cons: AtlasAI SLA exposure; needs legal/CS approval.
B) Burst sell: offer Skylab a burst-only top-up for the two weeks at a premium. Pros: avoids touching AtlasAI. Cons: cost to Skylab may be prohibitive and Skylab says they can’t absorb much additional cost.
C) Hybrid: small redistribution + burst top-up to minimize SLA exposure.

Please review the attached SLA_consequence_matrix.xlsx and the Skylab summary. Need a final call by 18:30Z today to meet their 9/14 decision deadline. Recommend Ben lead customer-facing terms and Rishi confirm SLA/legal constraints.

-Vanessa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T17:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: Q4 surge — Skylab request (conflict with AtlasAI tranche)

Vanessa — quick take after scanning the numbers: hybrid looks like the least-risk, fastest path. Concrete proposal:
- For 2027-10-18 -> 2027-10-31, allocate Skylab an additional 60% capacity by: 40% via limited redistribution from AtlasAI (pre-agreed, with a one-week notice to AtlasAI and a 10% credit toward their next invoice) and 20% via burst capacity sold at a 1.5x rate.
- Create a temporary SLA carve-out: inventory the AtlasAI SLAs that would be impacted and cap customer-visible degradation to 5% of p95 tail latency. Rishi — need your sign-off if this wording is acceptable for an exception.
- Commercial: add a one-time change order (deal SKy amendment) and a clause that the redistributed capacity must be returned to AtlasAI no later than 2027-11-05.

If we get internal OK, I’ll draft the email to Maya with the trade and the DocuSign change-order link. If AtlasAI pushes back, we fallback to burst-only (B).

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Maya Kline <maya.kline@skylab.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T19:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Q4 surge — proposed temporary allocation (needs confirmation)

Maya — quick update and proposed path forward. We appreciate how tight your launch timeline is. We can support the two-week elevated allocation (2027-10-18 -> 2027-10-31) with the following terms: 

1) Allocation mechanics: Skylab receives additional capacity equal to ~60% of your reserved tranche for the two-week window. 40% of that increase will come from a temporary redistribution of AtlasAI's tranche; 20% will be provided via burst capacity.
2) Commercials: one-time change order to reflect the temporary delta. AtlasAI will be issued a one-off credit (10% of the redistributed slice) as compensation. Skylab will be billed the burst portion at 1.5x normal rates for the window.
3) SLA/guardrails: We will document an SLA exception/limit for AtlasAI (inventory attached) to ensure customer-visible impact remains below a 5% p95 tail increase. This exception is time-boxed and will revert automatically on 2027-11-05.
4) Next steps: please confirm acceptance by EOD 2027-09-14. If accepted, we’ll send a DocuSign change order (link below) and notify AtlasAI of the temporary redistribution and credit.

DocuSign (preliminary change-order): https://docusign.net/prepare/ABC123456789
HubSpot deal (Skylab): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SKY-2027-0421

If you accept, Ben will send the formal change-order and Rishi will coordinate the SLA carve-out language.

Thanks — hope this gets you across the finish line.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T20:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: Q4 surge — final internal confirmation

All — I approve the hybrid approach in principle. Legal/compliance are comfortable with the timeboxed SLA carve-out if we: 1) document customer notification (we'll notify AtlasAI with rationale and credit amount), 2) lock the reversion date to 2027-11-05, and 3) log the exception in our incident/SLA register. Ben — proceed to prepare the change order and flag the credit on AtlasAI's next invoice. Vanessa — please update HubSpot (deal SKY-2027-0421) with the agreed amendment and the DocuSign link.

Rishi
